title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-06-16
content:
Applied ML weekly research notes (quantization, evals, model onboarding)
Week ending 2026-06-16
Owner: Maya Patel
Collaborators: Ethan Zhao, Priya Narayanan, Luis Fernandez
Status: in_review

Summary
- Focus this week: finalize int8 quantization baseline for the 13B candidate, expand eval harness to include hallucination/faithfulness suites, and unblock onboarding for Vendor-X bespoke Llama-derivative.
- Progress: int8 pipeline now produces stable runs across GPU types (A100/H100) with reproducible logit-level checks; baseline latency down ~30-35% on p99 for short prompts.
- Blockers: intermittent tokenizer mismatch on Vendor-X checkpoints; eval flakiness for open-domain QA (random seed sensitivity).

Key experiments and results
1) int8 quantization baseline (13B, causal LM)
- Goal: get a safe, production-ready int8 config that matches float32 perplexity within +2% and reduces latency/cost.
- Setup: calibration with 10K sequences sampled from Redwood internal prompt corpus (mix of instruction/chat/short prompts). Used per-channel quantization with 32-bit bias preservation.
- Hardware: H100 (v2) and A100 (40GB) test pools.
- Metrics (avg across 3 runs):
  - float32 ppl: 12.8; int8 ppl: 13.1 (+2.3%)
  - throughput (tokens/s) H100: float32 8200 -> int8 11800 (~+44%)
  - p99 latency (single-request, 64-token gen) A100: float32 120ms -> int8 78ms (~-35%)
  - max memory (GPU): float32 22GB -> int8 14.5GB
- Notes: small quality regression on long-form summarization prompts (drop in ROUGE-L ~1.8). Need targeted evals to ensure no user-visible regressions.
- Action items: run 50-shot human eval for summarization subset (assigned to Priya). Add int8 config to the staging model catalog with the tag "candidate-int8-2026-06-16".

2) int4 quick-probe (toy)
- Ran quick int4 experiments (symmetric quant) on a smaller 3B variant to gauge feasibility. Results are promising for throughput but large ppl regressions (int4 ppl +18%).
- Conclusion: int4 not ready for general-purpose 13B; might be suitable for highly cached, narrow-domain rerankers.
- Action: document findings in quantization playbook; schedule spike for mixed-precision (activation fp16 + weights int4) in July.

3) Eval harness expansion: hallucination + faithfulness
- Added two new suites to continuous eval: (a) multi-hop open-domain QA (WikiKG-derived), (b) instruction-following faithfulness checks (assertion consistency).
- Observations: int8 config increases factual hallucination rate by +1.5 percentage points on multi-hop QA. Correlated with lower ROUGE retention in certain prompt templates.
- Hypothesis: quantization noise amplifies attention distribution variance in long-range dependency cases.
- Immediate mitigation: fallback policy in inference router to float32 for requests flagged by prompt classifier (flag criteria: prompt length > 512 tokens OR contains multi-hop keywords).
- Action: add unit tests that generate synthetic multi-hop prompts and assert no >2% regression in factual accuracy after quantization. Ticketed as JIRA-APL-820.

4) Model onboarding: Vendor-X checkpoint (Llama-derivative)
- Received vendor checkpoint (v1.2) on 2026-06-10. Initial tokenization mismatch: vendor uses slightly different BOS/eos IDs and a custom <instr> token.
- Steps taken:
  - Wrote tokenizer mapping shim that aligns CS vocab to Redwood canonical vocab for inference-only path.
  - Verified embeddings mapping by computing cosine similarity on 1K tokens; avg cosine 0.997 (acceptable).
  - Ran smoke generation tests; observed subtle stop-sequence behavior differences (stop tokens not respected in ~4% cases).
- Blocker: vendor's training config not fully annotated; need confirmation on special tokens and attention mask behavior. Outreach to Vendor-X sent (ticket: PR#3487; owner: Luis).
- Action: vendor to provide token spec and a small deterministic generation example. If not received by 2026-06-20, escalate to PM.

Standup / daily logs (high-level)
- Mon 2026-06-08: kick-off int8 stability runs; set up reproducible CI job with deterministic seeds.
- Tue 2026-06-09: discovered tokenizer mismatch with Vendor-X; created mapping shim PR draft.
- Wed 2026-06-10: first int8 runs on A100; noted ROUGE drop on summarization.
- Thu 2026-06-11: expanded eval harness; added multi-hop QA suite.
- Fri 2026-06-12: p99 latency improvement observed; documented config and started human eval plan.

Blockers & risks
- Tokenizer/vendor spec missing -> blocks onboarding and quantization verification for Vendor-X models. (Owner: Luis Fernandez).
- Eval flakiness: some random-seed sensitivity in QA suite causing +/-2-3% variance. Need more stable sampling or larger eval seeds. (Owner: Ethan).
- Long-tail regressions in long-form generation after quantization; potential customer-facing impact if left unchecked. Mitigation: rollouts behind canary with auto-fallback and detailed regression alerts.

Plans for next week (2026-06-17 to 2026-06-23)
- Stabilize int8: run 10k-sample evals across full eval suite and produce a report (owner: Maya).
- Human eval for summarization subset (owner: Priya) to validate perceived quality differences.
- Vendor-X onboarding: vendor to provide token spec; integrate changes and rerun smoke tests (owner: Luis).
- Add unit/regression tests for multi-hop QA to CI; reduce seed sensitivity by increasing sample sizes and using stratified sampling (owner: Ethan).
- Spike: investigate mixed-precision (weights int4 + activations fp16) on 3B for throughput/quality tradeoffs (owner: Maya, target EOW).

Open questions
- For fallback policy: what should be the latency/quality threshold for auto-fallback to float32? Proposal: if predicted hallucination risk >0.6 OR observed confidence drop >8% in top-1 logits, route to float32. Need PM input.
- Should int8 be default for Dedicated customers on compatible hardware, or gated by account-level policy? Ops/privileged customers may prefer float32.

Notes to self / loose TODOs
- Add a small checklist to model onboarding docs: tokenizer spec, stop-token test, deterministic example, training config excerpt, validation prompt set.
- Add a column in the model catalog for "quant-support" with allowed quant levels and known regressions.
- Sync with Console team to ensure rollout flags are exposed in the UI for canarying quantized variants.

Linked artifacts / references
- JIRA-APL-812: quantization baseline work
- JIRA-APL-820: multi-hop QA regression tests
- PR#3487: Vendor-X tokenizer mapping shim
- confluence:applied-ml/quantization-playbook (playbook draft)
- s3://redwood-evals/2026-06-15/quant-results.csv (raw eval outputs)

Appendix: quick reproduce commands (for infra/eng)
- Run int8 calibration: ./tools/quant_calibrate --model ./checkpoints/13b --calib-set s3://redwood-calib/10k.jsonl --out ./quant/13b-int8 --per-channel true --preserve-bias true
- CI eval command: ./tools/eval_harness --model ./quant/13b-int8 --suites summarization,qa,multi-hop --seed 42 --out results/2026-06-15

End of notes
